description: AlphaFold AF-Q9HC38-F1 check against the crystal structures, plus summary figure of metal burial and metazoan conservation

import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
t2o={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse(txt):
    out=[]
    for L in txt.split("\n"):
        if L.startswith(('ATOM','HETATM')) and len(L)>54 and L[16] in ' A':
            if L[17:20].strip()=='HOH': continue
            out.append(dict(name=L[12:16].strip(),resn=L[17:20].strip(),chain=L[21],resi=int(L[22:26]),
                xyz=np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])]),b=float(L[60:66] or 0)))
    return out
AF=parse(requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q9HC38-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=120).text)
X =parse(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/9CSJ.pdb",timeout=120).text)
plddt={a['resi']:a['b'] for a in AF if a['name']=='CA'}
print("AlphaFold AF-Q9HC38-F1 (canonical isoform 1, %d residues)" % len(plddt))
print("  mean pLDDT = %.1f ; residues <70 = %d" % (np.mean(list(plddt.values())), sum(v<70 for v in plddt.values())))
# isoform1 -> isoform2 numbering: identical to 31, then iso1 63..313 == iso2 48..298 (offset -15)
def i1(i2): return i2 if i2<=31 else i2+15
for lab,i2 in [('His8',8),('Glu70',70),('Arg201',201),('Cys254',254),('Lys55',55),('Arg33',33)]:
    print(f"  {lab} (iso2) = residue {i1(i2)} in AF model, pLDDT {plddt.get(i1(i2),float('nan')):.1f}")
print("  pLDDT of the isoform-1-specific insert (32-62):", round(np.mean([plddt[i] for i in range(32,63) if i in plddt]),1))

# superpose AF model onto 9CSJ chain A using the equivalent residue pairs
pairs=[]
for i2 in list(range(1,32))+list(range(48,299)):
    a=[x for x in AF if x['name']=='CA' and x['resi']==i1(i2)]
    b=[x for x in X  if x['name']=='CA' and x['chain']=='A' and x['resi']==i2]
    if a and b: pairs.append((a[0]['xyz'],b[0]['xyz']))
P=np.array([p for p,q in pairs]); Q=np.array([q for p,q in pairs])
def kabsch(P,Q):
    cP,cQ=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); H=(P-cP).T@(Q-cQ); U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T)); R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T
    return R, cQ-R@cP
R,t=kabsch(P,Q); Pt=(R@P.T).T+t
dev=np.linalg.norm(Pt-Q,axis=1)
print(f"\nAF model vs 9CSJ chain A: {len(pairs)} equivalent CA pairs, RMSD {np.sqrt((dev**2).mean()):.2f} A, "
      f"{(dev<2).mean()*100:.0f}% within 2 A")
# does the AF model reproduce the metal site geometry (no metal in the model)?
def atom(S,ch,ri,nm):
    r=[x for x in S if x['resi']==ri and x['name']==nm and (ch is None or x['chain']==ch)]
    return r[0]['xyz'] if r else None
pairs2=[('His8 NE2 - Glu70 OE1',('HIS',8,'NE2'),('GLU',70,'OE1')),
        ('His8 NE2 - Cys254 SG',('HIS',8,'NE2'),('CYS',254,'SG')),
        ('Glu70 OE1 - Cys254 SG',('GLU',70,'OE1'),('CYS',254,'SG')),
        ('Glu70 OE1 - Arg201 NH2',('GLU',70,'OE1'),('ARG',201,'NH2')),
        ('His8 NE2 - Lys55 NZ',('HIS',8,'NE2'),('LYS',55,'NZ'))]
print(f"\n{'distance':<26}{'AF model':>11}{'9CSJ A (Zn-bound)':>20}{'3ZI1 (apo)':>13}")
Z=parse(requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/3ZI1.pdb",timeout=120).text)
for lab,(r1,p1,n1),(r2,p2,n2) in pairs2:
    a1=atom(AF,None,i1(p1),n1); a2=atom(AF,None,i1(p2),n2)
    b1=atom(X,'A',p1,n1);  b2=atom(X,'A',p2,n2)
    c1=atom(Z,'A',p1,n1);  c2=atom(Z,'A',p2,n2)
    f=lambda u,v: f"{np.linalg.norm(u-v):.2f}" if (u is not None and v is not None) else "n/a"
    print(f"{lab:<26}{f(a1,a2):>11}{f(b1,b2):>20}{f(c1,c2):>13}")
# place the crystal Zn into the AF frame
zn=[x for x in X if x['resn']=='ZN' and x['chain']=='A' and x['resi']==302][0]['xyz']
Rinv=R.T; zn_af=Rinv@(zn-t)
for lab,(rn,ri,nm) in [('His8 NE2',('HIS',8,'NE2')),('Glu70 OE1',('GLU',70,'OE1')),('Cys254 SG',('CYS',254,'SG')),
                        ('Lys55 NZ',('LYS',55,'NZ')),('Arg201 NH2',('ARG',201,'NH2'))]:
    a=atom(AF,None,i1(ri),nm)
    print(f"  AF model {lab} to crystal Zn position mapped into AF frame: {np.linalg.norm(a-zn_af):.2f} A")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.5))
ax[0].bar(['GLOD4 Zn\nHis8/Glu70\n(9CSJ A)','GLOD4 Zn\nHis8/Glu70\n(9CSJ B)','GLOD4 Zn\nHis8/Glu70\n(9CSJ C)',
           'GLOD4 Zn\nsurface His66','GLOD4 Zn\nsurface His291','GLO1 Zn\n(1QIN)','FosA Mn\n(1LQK)'],
          [13.53,13.53,18.10,36.36,42.39,3.26,11.76],
          color=['#2b6cb0']*3+['#a0aec0']*2+['#2f855a']*2)
ax[0].set_ylabel('metal solvent-accessible surface (A$^2$)')
ax[0].set_title('The His8/Glu70 Zn is enclosed like a catalytic VOC metal,\nunlike the two surface Zn in the same crystal', fontsize=10)
ax[0].tick_params(axis='x', labelsize=7)
pos=['H8','R33','K55','E70','R201','C254']
vert=[95.1,98.4,97.9,98.0,99.0,98.0]; inv=[100.0,99.0,100.0,100.0,100.0,99.0]
w=0.38; xi=np.arange(len(pos))
ax[1].bar(xi-w/2,vert,w,label='196 vertebrates'); ax[1].bar(xi+w/2,inv,w,label='106 non-vertebrate metazoans')
ax[1].set_xticks(xi); ax[1].set_xticklabels(pos); ax[1].set_ylim(80,103)
ax[1].set_ylabel('% identical'); ax[1].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_title('Metal site and Cys254 are invariant across Metazoa\n(sponge, cnidarian, arthropod, mollusc, amphioxus)', fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
